name: tygif weekly process (every game, every week)

sources.splits_consensus: ScoresAndOdds consensus (all books), last pull before kickoff
sources.splits_draftkings: DraftKings Network betting splits, last pull before kickoff
sources.spread_line: DraftKings via ESPN game summary (pickcenter); close for graded games
sources.moneyline: DraftKings via ESPN game summary (pickcenter); close for graded games
sources.monday_line: TeamRankings books 2-3, last quote before Monday 12:00 AM ET
sources.qb: ESPN injury report (Week 1 starter or named starter)

steps: Saturday: scripts/snapshot.py pulls ScoresAndOdds + DraftKings splits for every game; ESPN scoreboard, game summaries and injury report for every game
Rate every game under Rules v1 (rating, type, checks a-e) from those sources only
Spread call = fade the money side; ML call = same side, graded in its rating + type + favorite/underdog group; posted only if the group is profitable (> $0)
Tuesday: grade every STRONG/LEAN spread and moneyline at the DraftKings close (ESPN), flat $100, profit rounded per play; write data/live_log.csv and data/ml_log.json
Rebuild with clean_build.py; the build fails if any game misses a field or uses a source not listed here (unless it is a recorded gap)

weeks_1_4.splits_consensus: ScoresAndOdds consensus as displayed after the game (page not timestamped); pre-kickoff pulls were not saved
weeks_1_4.qb: nflverse starters (Week 1 starter vs actual starter)

known_gaps.week_5_draftkings: DraftKings closing split not captured for some games; last DraftKings pull before kickoff used (listed per game in data/closing_splits.json)
